§6Station Control Blocks§f include the Gravity Controller, Orientation Controller, Altitude Controller, Planet Selector, and Holo Selector. Together they manage your space station's environment and navigation.

The Gravity Controller creates a spherical gravity field up to 64 blocks radius. It needs RF power, 100 RF/t baseline plus 1 RF/t per block of radius. Without it, the station is zero-G and you need jetpacks to move.

The Orientation and Altitude Controllers stabilize the station. The Planet Selector and Holo Selector provide 3D navigation previews.

§ePS:§f Multiple Gravity Controllers can link to extend the field for larger stations. Place them spread out for even coverage.
